name: DishChannelArea
formula: =LAMBDA(Width,Height,LET(W, Width, H, -Height, a, -4 * H / W ^ 2, b, 4 * H / W, area, a * W ^ 3 / 3 + b * W ^ 2 / 2, ABS(area)))
comment:
This formula returns the cross section area of arc shape dish-channel, which is a three points arc defined by coordinates (0,0), (B/2,-H) and (B,0).
Last Update 2024-04-22.
